definition: Pagination divides a large service result set into smaller pages retrieved through separate calls.
A continuation token records where the CLI should resume retrieving a result set.
A pager is a local program that displays terminal output one screen at a time.
Throttling is a service response that limits an excessive request rate and can be retried.
A transient error is a temporary failure such as a connection problem that may succeed on retry.
Exponential backoff increases waiting time between retry attempts.
A return code is the process status that a CLI command reports after it finishes.
